crossRefs.note: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night…
in the third year of his reign, he made a feast for all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media…

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

translations.web: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.
translations.bsb: When Abner and twenty of his men came to David at Hebron, David held a feast for them.
translations.kjv: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.
translations.asv: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.
